verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes first-party API documentation at zulip.com/api/, including a documented send-message endpoint, and describes an API-based framework for interactive bots that can be deployed with the Zulip Botserver. That covers the core of driving the product programmatically through a documented public API. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs at the paths tried, which weakens machine-readable discoverability but does not contradict that the API exists. Missing for 10: evidence of endpoint breadth beyond sending messages, a machine-readable spec at a discoverable path, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
